Successfully recorded payout for 'acme'. Now I will record the payout for 'birch'.
Successfully recorded payout for 'birch'. Finally, I will record the payout for 'cobalt'.
All payouts have been successfully recorded for acme, birch, and cobalt. I can now finalize the task by reporting the successful payouts.
